instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot. Next to a textured white wall in bright daylight, the man in the beige polo shirt (R1) stands on the left, looking to the right with a calm expression and hands clasped. Beside him, the woman in the black strapless top and white jacket (R2) leans her head back with eyes closed and a soft smile, her arm resting on the wall behind him. Strong sunlight from the left casts sharp shadows on the wall.
elements: R2 rests her arm on the wall behind R1 rather than R1 resting an arm behind R2
R1 keeps his hands clasped while R2 uses the wall behind him
R2 leans her head back with eyes closed beside R1 while R1 remains upright and calm
textured white wall behind/next to the pair
bright outdoor daylight with sharp wall shadows

questions.element: R2's arm rests on the wall behind R1

questions.element: R1 has clasped hands while R2 uses the wall behind him

questions.q: Is R2 leaning her head back with eyes closed beside R1 while R1 remains upright with a calm expression?
questions.element: R2 leans back with eyes closed while R1 stands calmly
